declared: ROBOLEARN-10 (loop 10 round 9): a learner's own consented takes join a training run of the small model, on the device, declared here before the first run. This is a training declaration only: no held-out seed is run, no comparison is made and no claim of improvement follows from it. The held-out ranges 7121–7300 are spent and are never re-run; 7301–7360 are not touched by this run.

run.model: ra-lm-h (RA_LM_H_TRAIN: epochs 10, lr 0.1, l2 1e-4, seed 1, hidden 24, interruptText true; unchanged)

trainingData.synthetic: the arena's development-seed demonstrations, RA_DEMOS { n 40, seed 1, skill 0.85, noise 0.3 } → episode seeds 100004–100043 per gym task (colSyntheticDemos), labelled synthetic
trainingData.consented: the learner's own takes from the local DX store, read through colLocalDemos only while dxCollecting() holds (signed in, not demo, not K-12 or classroom, adult opt-in); each validated by dxValidateEpisode and refused without an adult consent receipt

run.tasks: the six gym tasks the small model trains on (RA_LM_TASKS); station tasks join only when station texts are supplied
run.where: on the device; nothing is sent anywhere; no network call, no external API, no key
run.evaluation: none. The run builds a model and reports what went into it. Any comparison of a takes-trained model would need its own declaration on a fresh held-out range first.
run.provenance: one row per take (episode id, task, steps, consent receipt id, licence, adult); inside the model, raLmTrain's per-sample counts (synthetic rows, human rows, refused episodes, by task)
run.revoke: dxRevoke deletes every stored take; the next run finds 0 and rebuilds the model without them. check_arena 12 holds that the rebuilt model's weights hash equals the model built before any take existed.

checks.check_arena 12: fixture store: signed out → not collecting, 0 takes, no model; opted-in adult with one receipted take → 1 take with its receipt, human rows > 0; K-12 or demo → 0; after revoke → 0 takes, human rows 0, weights hash equal to the no-takes model; the demonstration seeds are disjoint from every held-out range (7121–7360)
